findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/prep-attach.js::confirm on an already-attached marker silently replaces comment_id
findings.title: confirm on an already-attached marker silently replaces comment_id
findings.action: Refuse a confirm on an attached marker, or keep the first comment_id.
findings.disposition_rationale: The accepted spec (section 4.6) defines this case: confirm on an attached marker returns attached and records the new comment_id. Confirm still re-hashes the staged body, so only the staged bytes can be confirmed, and the newest comment is the one graft reads.

occurrences.title: confirm on an already-attached marker silently replaces comment_id

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/prep-attach.js::an unclosed fence can leave a second build-tier line inside it
findings.title: an unclosed fence can leave a second build-tier line inside it
findings.action: Treat an unclosed fence as malformed, or check the mask after filtering.
findings.disposition_rationale: It needs a spec whose fence never closes and that carries a build-tier line after the opener: a malformed spec the readiness fold and spec review would already flag. The spec's edge cases do not cover it.

occurrences.title: an unclosed fence can leave a second build-tier line inside it

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/spec-judge-evidence.js::readstandingresidue n comes from the file name, not the round record
findings.title: readStandingResidue n comes from the file name, not the round record
findings.action: Check the record's own round number against the file name.
findings.disposition_rationale: Round records carry no round field ({verdict, objections}); collateSpecReviewRounds keys by the same file-name number, so both readers agree by construction, and any mismatch fails loud with exit 1.

occurrences.title: readStandingResidue n comes from the file name, not the round record

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/prep-attach.js::findroot can throw outside the try in cmdprep
findings.title: findRoot can throw outside the try in cmdPrep
findings.action: Wrap findRoot in the try and return errored.
findings.disposition_rationale: findRoot never throws: it walks up for .git or .faff and returns the start directory when it finds neither.

occurrences.title: findRoot can throw outside the try in cmdPrep
